# GitHub files

Community health files and CI for this contracts repository. Work lands on `main` from short-lived branches. This project does not use GitHub Issues or Pull Requests.

Sources:

- [Creating a default community health file](https://docs.github.com/en/communities/setting-up-your-project-for-healthy-contributions/creating-a-default-community-health-file)
- [github/.github CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/github/.github/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [Contributor Covenant 2.1](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/)
- [Electron SECURITY.md](https://github.com/electron/electron/blob/main/SECURITY.md) as cited by GitHub Docs
- [actions/starter-workflows python-package.yml](https://github.com/actions/starter-workflows/blob/main/ci/python-package.yml)
- [Dependabot github-actions example](https://docs.github.com/en/code-security/how-tos/secure-your-supply-chain/secure-your-dependencies/auto-update-actions)
- [GitHub Flow](https://docs.github.com/en/get-started/using-github/github-flow)
- [Google Small CLs](https://google.github.io/eng-practices/review/developer/small-cls.html)
- [Conventional Commits 1.0.0](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/en/v1.0.0/)
